ValidationRule.description: PacPoint-IC071719- Created for PVL phase 1 Do not allow the user to move the phase if the Number of Deficiencies is greater than 0
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED( Phase__c ), ISPICKVAL( Phase__c , "H - License Generation"), NOT(ISPICKVAL( Status__c , "HD - Application Terminated")), NumberofDeficiencies__c > 0, Bypass_Validation__c = false )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Cannot change the Phase if the Number of Deficiencies is greater than 0.
